description: Smart Battery Data Specification v1.1 command set, spec only. Battery at 7-bit 0x0B (SMBus 3.3 Table 17); battery-master messages to the Charger (0x09) and Host (0x08). Sources: SBDS Rev 1.0 (functions, units, bits, error codes, protocols), errata_sbdat110a (v1.1 BatteryMode ALARM_MODE and SpecificationInfo codes), SBS 1.1 command tables (OptionalMfgFunction 0x2F, 0x3C-0x3F). Values are shown in base units: capacity/rate rules depend on BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE and voltages/currents/capacities are further x 10^VScale / 10^IPScale per SpecificationInfo; the decoder applies neither. Words are LE. Reserved: 0x1D-0x1F, 0x24-0x2E, 0x30-0x3B, 0x40-0xFF; the upper two command bits are reserved for multi-battery addressing. Multi-address file (rules carry their own address). Generated by build_sbds_decoder.py.
byte_order_note: SMBus words: Data Byte Low first (SBDS 1.0 §6.1).

rules.name: ManufacturerAccess
rules.description: SBS 0x00 ManufacturerAccess(), Read Word, LE. Optional; content manufacturer specific. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.1]

rules.name: ManufacturerAccess (set)
rules.description: SBS 0x00 ManufacturerAccess(), Write Word, LE. Optional; content manufacturer specific. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.1]

rules.name: RemainingCapacityAlarm
rules.description: SBS 0x01 RemainingCapacityAlarm(), Read Word, LE. Low-capacity alarm threshold; 0 disables. Default 10% of DesignCapacity. Unit per BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE (0x03 bit 15): 0 = mAh, 1 = 10 mWh. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.2]

rules.name: RemainingCapacityAlarm (set)
rules.description: SBS 0x01 RemainingCapacityAlarm(), Write Word, LE. Low-capacity alarm threshold; 0 disables. Default 10% of DesignCapacity. Unit per BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE (0x03 bit 15): 0 = mAh, 1 = 10 mWh. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.2]

rules.name: RemainingTimeAlarm
rules.description: SBS 0x02 RemainingTimeAlarm(), Read Word, LE. Remaining-time alarm threshold vs AverageTimeToEmpty; 0 disables. Default 10 min. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.3]

rules.name: RemainingTimeAlarm (set)
rules.description: SBS 0x02 RemainingTimeAlarm(), Write Word, LE. Remaining-time alarm threshold vs AverageTimeToEmpty; 0 disables. Default 10 min. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.3]

rules.name: BatteryMode
rules.description: SBS 0x03 BatteryMode(), Read Word, LE. MSB r/w, LSB read only. CHARGER_MODE and CAPACITY_MODE clear on entering the on state (§4.4.4). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.4 + Errata]

bit_fields.name: CONDITION_FLAG
bit_fields.description: Read only. Renamed RELEARN_FLAG in errata 1.1a.

rules.name: BatteryMode (set)
rules.description: SBS 0x03 BatteryMode(), Write Word, LE. MSB r/w, LSB read only. CHARGER_MODE and CAPACITY_MODE clear on entering the on state (§4.4.4). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.4 + Errata]

bit_fields.name: CONDITION_FLAG
bit_fields.description: Read only. Renamed RELEARN_FLAG in errata 1.1a.

rules.name: AtRate
rules.description: SBS 0x04 AtRate(), Read Word, LE. Signed: + charge, - discharge, 0 default. Unit per CAPACITY_MODE: 0 = mA, 1 = 10 mW. Also x 10^IPScale. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.5]

rules.name: AtRate (set)
rules.description: SBS 0x04 AtRate(), Write Word, LE. Signed: + charge, - discharge, 0 default. Unit per CAPACITY_MODE: 0 = mA, 1 = 10 mW. Also x 10^IPScale. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.5]

rules.name: AtRateTimeToFull
rules.description: SBS 0x05 AtRateTimeToFull(), Read Word, LE. At AtRate. 65535 = not being charged. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.6]

rules.name: AtRateTimeToEmpty
rules.description: SBS 0x06 AtRateTimeToEmpty(), Read Word, LE. At AtRate. 65535 = not being discharged. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.7]

rules.name: AtRateOK
rules.description: SBS 0x07 AtRateOK(), Read Word, LE. Boolean: 0 = FALSE, non-zero = TRUE. Always TRUE when AtRate >= 0. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.8]

rules.name: Temperature
rules.description: SBS 0x08 Temperature(), Read Word, LE. 0.1 K/LSB, shown in degC. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.9]

rules.name: Voltage
rules.description: SBS 0x09 Voltage(), Read Word, LE. Pack voltage. Also x 10^VScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.10]

rules.name: Current
rules.description: SBS 0x0A Current(), Read Word, LE. Signed: + charge, - discharge. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.11]

rules.name: AverageCurrent
rules.description: SBS 0x0B AverageCurrent(), Read Word, LE. One-minute rolling average, signed. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.12]

rules.name: MaxError
rules.description: SBS 0x0C MaxError(), Read Word, LE. Expected SoC error margin, 0-100. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.13]

rules.name: RelativeStateOfCharge
rules.description: SBS 0x0D RelativeStateOfCharge(), Read Word, LE. % of FullChargeCapacity. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.14]

rules.name: AbsoluteStateOfCharge
rules.description: SBS 0x0E AbsoluteStateOfCharge(), Read Word, LE. % of DesignCapacity; may exceed 100. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.15]

rules.name: RemainingCapacity
rules.description: SBS 0x0F RemainingCapacity(), Read Word, LE. Predicted remaining capacity. Unit per BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE (0x03 bit 15): 0 = mAh, 1 = 10 mWh. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.16]

rules.name: FullChargeCapacity
rules.description: SBS 0x10 FullChargeCapacity(), Read Word, LE. Predicted full capacity. Unit per BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE (0x03 bit 15): 0 = mAh, 1 = 10 mWh. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.17]

rules.name: RunTimeToEmpty
rules.description: SBS 0x11 RunTimeToEmpty(), Read Word, LE. At present rate. 65535 = not being discharged. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.18]

rules.name: AverageTimeToEmpty
rules.description: SBS 0x12 AverageTimeToEmpty(), Read Word, LE. One-minute average. 65535 = not being discharged. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.19]

rules.name: AverageTimeToFull
rules.description: SBS 0x13 AverageTimeToFull(), Read Word, LE. One-minute average. 65535 = not being charged. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.20]

rules.name: ChargingCurrent
rules.description: SBS 0x14 ChargingCurrent(), Read Word, LE. Battery's desired charge current, polled by a level-3 charger or host. 0 = charger off; 65535 = operate as voltage source. Not affected by SpecificationInfo scaling (Errata). [SBDS 1.0 §5.3.1]

rules.name: ChargingVoltage
rules.description: SBS 0x15 ChargingVoltage(), Read Word, LE. Battery's desired charge voltage. 0 = charger off; 65535 = operate as current source. Not affected by SpecificationInfo scaling (Errata). [SBDS 1.0 §5.3.2]

rules.name: BatteryStatus
rules.description: SBS 0x16 BatteryStatus(), Read Word, LE. Alarm/status flags and error code. Bits 13 and 10 reserved. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.21 + App C]

bit_fields.name: ErrorCode
bit_fields.description: [3:0] error code of the last command (SBDS 1.0 App C).

rules.name: CycleCount
rules.description: SBS 0x17 CycleCount(), Read Word, LE. 65535 = 65535 or more cycles. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.22]

rules.name: DesignCapacity
rules.description: SBS 0x18 DesignCapacity(), Read Word, LE. Theoretical new-pack capacity. Unit per BatteryMode CAPACITY_MODE (0x03 bit 15): 0 = mAh, 1 = 10 mWh. Also x 10^IPScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.23]

rules.name: DesignVoltage
rules.description: SBS 0x19 DesignVoltage(), Read Word, LE. Theoretical new-pack voltage. Also x 10^VScale (SpecificationInfo). [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.24]

rules.name: SpecificationInfo
rules.description: SBS 0x1A SpecificationInfo(), Read Word, LE. Packed version and scaling. Scaling does not apply to ChargingCurrent/ChargingVoltage. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.25 + Errata]

rules.name: ManufactureDate
rules.description: SBS 0x1B ManufactureDate(), Read Word, LE. (year-1980)*512 + month*32 + day. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.26]

rules.name: SerialNumber
rules.description: SBS 0x1C SerialNumber(), Read Word, LE. Unsigned. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.27]

rules.name: ManufacturerName
rules.description: SBS 0x20 ManufacturerName(), Block Read: length byte then data, 32 bytes max (SBDS 1.0 App B). String. Text appears in the capture's ASCII column. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.28]

rules.name: DeviceName
rules.description: SBS 0x21 DeviceName(), Block Read: length byte then data, 32 bytes max (SBDS 1.0 App B). String. Text appears in the capture's ASCII column. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.29]

rules.name: DeviceChemistry
rules.description: SBS 0x22 DeviceChemistry(), Block Read: length byte then data, 32 bytes max (SBDS 1.0 App B). String, e.g. PbAc, LION, NiCd, NiMH, NiZn, RAM, ZnAr (not case sensitive). Text appears in the capture's ASCII column. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.30]

rules.name: ManufacturerData
rules.description: SBS 0x23 ManufacturerData(), Block Read: length byte then data, 32 bytes max (SBDS 1.0 App B). Manufacturer-defined data. Text appears in the capture's ASCII column. [SBDS 1.0 §5.1.31]

rules.name: ChargingCurrent
rules.description: SBS 0x14 ChargingCurrent(), Write Word, LE. Battery -> Charger broadcast (or Host -> Charger), 5 s-1 min interval. 0 = charger off; 65535 = operate as voltage source. Not affected by SpecificationInfo scaling (Errata). [SBDS 1.0 §5.2.1]

rules.name: ChargingVoltage
rules.description: SBS 0x15 ChargingVoltage(), Write Word, LE. Battery -> Charger broadcast. 0 = charger off; 65535 = operate as current source. Not affected by SpecificationInfo scaling (Errata). [SBDS 1.0 §5.2.2]

rules.name: AlarmWarning to Charger
rules.description: SBS 0x16 AlarmWarning to Charger(), Write Word, LE. Battery master Write Word; command code = battery address byte 0x16. Charging-related alarms only; repeats every 10 s. [SBDS 1.0 §5.4.1, §6.3]

rules.name: AlarmWarning to Host
rules.description: SBS 0x16 AlarmWarning to Host(), Write Word, LE. Battery master Write Word to the SMBus Host; command code = battery address byte 0x16 (an SMBus Host Notify from 0x0B). All alarms; repeats every 10 s. [SBDS 1.0 §5.4.1, §6.3]
